name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: LibrePhotos single-container image backed by a bundled PostgreSQL database for larger libraries and multiple users.

alerts.message: Open the site right after deploying: the first-time setup wizard lets whoever reaches it first create the admin account.
LibrePhotos needs 4 GB of RAM at minimum and 8 GB or more for smooth face recognition, tagging and captioning on the CPU; the models download on first use and take several GB of disk.
